description.zh: 智能体环境音配置。不传表示不使用环境配置。
description.en: Configuration for the agent's ambient sound. If this parameter is not specified, ambient sound is disabled.

description.zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: The application ID. You can obtain this ID from the console. Only one ID can be specified.

description.zh:
对话模式：
- 1: 自然对话模式（默认）
- 2: 对讲机模式
description.en:
The chat mode:

- `1`: Natural conversation mode (default)

- `2`: Walkie-talkie mode

description.zh: 如果开启，LLM模型必须支持多模态数据。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable video understanding. If enabled, the specified LLM must support multimodal data.

description.zh: 问候语，最大长度不超过500。
description.en: The greeting message. The maximum length is 500 characters.

description.zh:
打断方式：
- 1: 支持打断（默认）
- 2: 禁止打断
description.en:
The interrupt mode:

- `1`: Allow interrupt (default)

- `2`: Disable interrupt

description.zh:
开启视觉理解后，可以设置智能体优先理解的视频流。
智能体只能理解一路视频流，当Camera流和屏幕共享流同时推流

1 - 智能体优先理解Camera流；

2 - 智能体优先理解屏幕共享流；

默认优先理解Camera流。
description.en:
When `EnableVideoUnderstanding` is `true`, this parameter specifies which video stream to prioritize if both a camera stream and a screen sharing stream are being published. The agent can only process one stream at a time.

`1`: Prioritize the camera stream (Default)

`2`: Prioritize the screen sharing stream

description.zh:
智能体类型：
- 1: 语音通话（默认）

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

This API has a single-user limit of 10 QPS (Queries Per Second). Exceeding this limit will result in your API calls being throttled, which may impact your business operations.
